title: 2 arrested in Ilocos Norte explosives buy-bust

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Police arrested a 36-year-old man and an 80-year-old woman and seized a large quantity of explosive materials in a buy-bust operation in Badoc, Ilocos Norte on Wednesday. In a report on Thursday, police said the Badoc Municipal Police Station and other law enforcement units conducted the operation at 10:19 a.m. along a provincial road near Barangay La Virgen Milagrosa. Police said the suspects were allegedly caught selling explosive materials to a police poseur buyer in exchange for P15,000.
